format: All original rows 0..9310. templates already read in IDs0..162. block=[start,count,template-id,argument-column-ids,slack-id-column-id]. Column expression literals concatenate; [R,value,n] repeats value n times; [A,start,step,n] is arithmetic sequence; [P,expression,n] repeats decoded expression n times. Template fragments are interleaved with str(integer) args. Slack dictionaries retained exactly in block-slacks.json. Additional E(expression,n) repeats every decoded element n times, and C(start,count) lists i,j for all start≤i<j<start+count in lexicographic order. Every replacement is decode-equal to the original full JSON.
